required.quote: The Board shall, as a prerequisite for the: ... (c) Biennial registration of the holder of a license to practice medicine, require each holder to submit evidence of compliance with the requirements for continuing education as set forth in regulations adopted by the Board.

value: terrorism/weapons of mass destruction (at least 4 hours within 2 years of initial licensure)
evidence-based suicide prevention and awareness (at least 2 hours within 2 years of initial licensure; at least 2 hours every 4 years thereafter)
screening, brief intervention and referral to treatment for substance use disorder (at least 2 hours within 2 years of initial licensure)
opioid prescribing/substance use disorder training (at least 2 hours per licensure period, for those registered to dispense controlled substances)
cultural competency and diversity, equity and inclusion for psychiatrists (at least 2 hours biennially)
HIV stigma/discrimination training for physicians providing emergency or primary care (at least 2 hours within 2 years of beginning such services)
topical_requirements.quote: Must provide for the completion of a course of instruction, within 2 years after initial licensure, relating to the medical consequences of an act of terrorism ... Must provide for the completion by a holder of a license to practice medicine of a course of instruction within 2 years after initial licensure that provides at least 2 hours of instruction on evidence-based suicide prevention and awareness ... Must provide for the completion of at least 2 hours of training in the screening, brief intervention and referral to treatment approach to substance use disorder within 2 years after initial licensure.

available.quote: the Board may issue a license by endorsement to practice medicine to an applicant who has been issued a license to practice medicine by the District of Columbia or any state or territory of the United States

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a current license in good standing in another state/territory/DC, pass an approved examination, meet all statutory requirements except NRS 630.160, submit required documentation, and complete any additional fitness requirements set by the Board. Expedited endorsement pathways available for ABMS-certified specialists (NRS 630.1606, 630.1607).
requirements.quote: the Board may issue a license by endorsement to practice medicine to an applicant who has been issued a license to practice medicine by the District of Columbia or any state or territory of the United States if: (a) At the time the applicant files an application with the Board, the license is in effect

exists.quote: the Board shall, in the interest of the public, judiciously: (a) Enforce the provisions of this chapter; (b) Establish by regulation standards for licensure under this chapter

national_certification.quote: Is currently certified by a specialty board of the American Board of Medical Specialties and who agrees to maintain the certification for the duration of the licensure

national_association.value: American Medical Association (AMA) / Association of American Medical Colleges (AAMC)
national_association.quote: Approved by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education of the American Medical Association and Association of American Medical Colleges

regulatory_model.quote: Every person desiring to practice medicine must, before beginning to practice, procure from the Board a license authorizing the person to practice.

credential_type.quote: Every person desiring to practice medicine must, before beginning to practice, procure from the Board a license authorizing the person to practice.

is_mandatory.quote: Except as otherwise provided by a specific statute, practice medicine, perfusion or respiratory care without being licensed under this chapter

title_protection.quote: Hold himself or herself out as a perfusionist or use any other term indicating or implying that he or she is a perfusionist without being licensed by the Board

scope_protection.quote: Except as otherwise provided by a specific statute, practice medicine, perfusion or respiratory care without being licensed under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, mental or physical condition, or substance use
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety because of illness, a mental or physical condition or the use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics or any other substance.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in conduct intended to deceive, violating Board standards, or violating pharmacy law applicable to practitioners
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in any conduct: (1) Which is intended to deceive; (2) Which the Board has determined is a violation of the standards of practice established by regulation of the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering, dispensing, or prescribing controlled substances or dangerous drugs to self or others except as authorized by law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering, dispensing or prescribing any controlled substance, or any dangerous drug as defined in chapter 454 of NRS, to or for himself or herself or to others except as authorized by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing, assisting, or advising injection of liquid silicone into the human body (except for retinal detachment repair)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing, assisting or advising the injection of any substance containing liquid silicone into the human body, except for the use of silicone oil to repair a retinal detachment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or offering to practice beyond the scope permitted by law or performing services the licensee is not competent to perform
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing or offering to practice beyond the scope permitted by law or performing services which the licensee knows or has reason to know that he or she is not competent to perform or which are beyond the scope of his or her training.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing experimental procedures or prescribing experimental therapies without first obtaining informed consent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing, without first obtaining the informed consent of the patient or the patient's family, any procedure or prescribing any therapy which by the current standards of the practice of medicine is experimental.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Continual failure to exercise the skill, diligence, or methods ordinarily used by physicians in the same specialty under the same circumstances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Continual failure to exercise the skill or diligence or use the methods ordinarily exercised under the same circumstances by physicians in good standing practicing in the same specialty or field.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having an alcohol or other substance use disorder
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having an alcohol or other substance use disorder.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or filing a report known to be false, or failing to file a required record or report
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or filing a report which the licensee or applicant knows to be false or failing to file a record or report as required by law or regulation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report in writing within 30 days any disciplinary action taken against the licensee by another state, federal government, or foreign country
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure by a licensee or applicant to report in writing, within 30 days, any disciplinary action taken against the licensee or applicant by another state, the Federal Government or a foreign country

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report in writing within 30 days any criminal action or conviction other than minor traffic violations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure by a licensee or applicant to report in writing, within 30 days, any criminal action taken or conviction obtained against the licensee or applicant, other than a minor traffic violation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to be found competent to practice medicine following a competency examination ordered by the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to be found competent to practice medicine as a result of an examination to determine medical competency pursuant to NRS 630.318.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Operating a medical facility while its license is suspended or revoked, or when an act occurs that causes suspension or revocation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Operation of a medical facility at any time during which: (1) The license of the facility is suspended or revoked; or (2) An act or omission occurs which results in the suspension or revocation of the license pursuant to NRS 449.160.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in any act that constitutes unsafe or unprofessional conduct under Board regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in any act that is unsafe or unprofessional conduct in accordance with regulations adopted by the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly or willfully procuring or administering an FDA-unapproved controlled substance or dangerous drug outside specified exceptions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly or willfully procuring or administering a controlled substance or a dangerous drug as defined in chapter 454 of NRS that is not approved by the United States Food and Drug Administration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to adequately supervise a medical assistant pursuant to Board regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to supervise adequately a medical assistant pursuant to the regulations of the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing or supervising a pelvic examination in violation of NRS 629.085
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing or supervising the performance of a pelvic examination in violation of NRS 629.085.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony relating to the practice of medicine or ability to practice medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony relating to the practice of medicine. A plea of nolo contendere is a conviction for the purposes of this subsection.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary action including revocation, suspension, modification or limitation of a license in another jurisdiction, or surrender while under investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any disciplinary action, including, without limitation, the revocation, suspension, modification or limitation of a license to practice any type of medicine, taken by another state, the Federal Government, a foreign country or any other jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Malpractice, which may be evidenced by settled claims, established by a preponderance of the evidence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Malpractice, which may be evidenced by claims settled against a practitioner, but only if the malpractice is established by a preponderance of the evidence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in sexual activity with a patient currently being treated by the practitioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The engaging by a practitioner in any sexual activity with a patient who is currently being treated by the practitioner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disruptive behavior that interferes with patient care or adversely impacts quality of care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Disruptive behavior with physicians, hospital personnel, patients, members of the families of patients or any other persons if the behavior interferes with patient care or has an adverse impact on the quality of care rendered to a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in conduct that violates patient trust and exploits the physician-patient relationship for financial or personal gain
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The engaging in conduct that violates the trust of a patient and exploits the relationship between the physician and the patient for financial or other personal gain.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining, maintaining, or renewing a license by bribery, fraud, misrepresentation, or false or misleading statements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining, maintaining or renewing or attempting to obtain, maintain or renew a license to practice medicine by bribery, fraud or misrepresentation or by any false, misleading, inaccurate or incomplete statement.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising the practice of medicine in a false, deceptive, or misleading manner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising the practice of medicine in a false, deceptive or misleading manner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain proper medical records, altering records, making false reports, or obstructing required filings
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to maintain timely, legible, accurate and complete medical records relating to the diagnosis, treatment and care of a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulent, illegal, unauthorized, or inappropriate prescribing, administering, or dispensing of Schedule II, III, or IV controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraudulent, illegal, unauthorized or otherwise inappropriate prescribing, administering or dispensing of a controlled substance listed in schedule II, III or IV.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly or willfully failing to comply with a Board regulation, subpoena, order, or court order relating to the chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Except as otherwise provided in NRS 630.2672, knowingly or willfully failing to comply with: (a) A regulation, subpoena or order of the Board or a committee designated by the Board to investigate a complaint against a physician

definition_quote.value: Practice of medicine means: 1. To diagnose, treat, correct, prevent or prescribe for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity or other condition, physical or mental, by any means or instrumentality, including, but not limited to, the performance of an autopsy. 2. To apply principles or techniques of medical science in the diagnosis or the prevention of any such conditions. 3. To perform any of the acts described in subsections 1 and 2 by using equipment that transfers information concerning the medical condition of the patient electronically, telephonically or by fiber optics, including, without limitation, through telehealth, from within or outside this State or the United States. 4. To offer, undertake, attempt to do or hold oneself out as able to do any of the acts described in subsections 1 and 2.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of medicine" means: 1. To diagnose, treat, correct, prevent or prescribe for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity or other condition, physical or mental, by any means or instrumentality, including, but not limited to, the performance of an autopsy.

value: telehealth/electronic/telephonic/fiber optic transmission of medical services
methods_authorized.quote: To diagnose, treat, correct, prevent or prescribe for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity or other condition, physical or mental, by any means or instrumentality

drug_authority.value: Physicians may prescribe, administer, and dispense controlled substances and dangerous drugs as authorized by law, including for treatment of intractable pain; may prescribe investigational drugs/biological products to patients with life-threatening or severely debilitating conditions with informed consent; may issue standing orders for epinephrine to schools and authorized entities.
drug_authority.quote: Administering, dispensing or prescribing any controlled substance, or any dangerous drug as defined in chapter 454 of NRS, to or for himself or herself or to others except as authorized by law.

license_status_types.quote: the Board may issue: (a) A locum tenens license ... (b) A special license ... (c) A restricted license ... (d) A temporary license ... (e) A special purpose license

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must submit proof of receipt of the degree of doctor of medicine or its equivalent, plus the standard certificate of the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG) or a written statement from ECFMG that the applicant passed its examination.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: an applicant for a license to practice medicine who is a graduate of a foreign medical school shall submit to the Board proof that the applicant has received: (a) The degree of doctor of medicine or its equivalent, as determined by the Board; and (b) The standard certificate of the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates or a written statement from that Commission that the applicant passed the examination given by the Commission.

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: Has completed 36 months of progressive postgraduate: (I) Education as a resident in the United States or Canada in a program approved by the Board, the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education

pain_management_education_required.quote: require each physician or physician assistant who is registered to dispense controlled substances pursuant to NRS 453.231 to complete at least 2 hours of training relating specifically to persons with substance use and other addictive disorders and the prescribing of opioids during each period of licensure.

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: Failure to comply with the requirements of NRS 453.163, 453.164, 453.226, 639.23507, 639.23535 and 639.2391 to 639.23916, inclusive, and any regulations adopted by the State Board of Pharmacy pursuant thereto.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: The practice of medicine expressly includes performing acts via equipment that transfers medical information electronically, telephonically, or by fiber optics, including through telehealth, from within or outside the State or the United States. A special purpose license exists for out-of-state physicians to practice via telehealth.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: To perform any of the acts described in subsections 1 and 2 by using equipment that transfers information concerning the medical condition of the patient electronically, telephonically or by fiber optics, including, without limitation, through telehealth, from within or outside this State or the United States.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: A special purpose license to a physician who is licensed in another state to perform any of the acts described in subsections 1 and 2 of NRS 630.020 by using equipment that transfers information concerning the medical condition of a patient in this State electronically, telephonically or by fiber optics, including, without limitation, through telehealth

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: Any communication between the Board and the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact Commission created by NRS 629A.100 relating to verification of a physician's eligibility for expedited licensure pursuant to that section

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: A physician assistant may perform such medical services as the physician assistant is authorized to perform by his or her supervising physician.

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: Physician assistants may prescribe controlled substances limited to the schedules the supervising physician is authorized to prescribe under state and federal law.
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: The Board and supervising physician shall limit the authority of a physician assistant to prescribe controlled substances to those schedules of controlled substances that the supervising physician is authorized to prescribe pursuant to state and federal law.

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: A physician, physician assistant, practitioner of respiratory care or perfusionist shall report to the Board: (a) Any action for malpractice against the physician ... not later than 45 days after the physician ... receives service of a summons and complaint

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: any hospital, clinic or other medical facility licensed in this State, or medical society, shall report to the Board any change in the privileges of a physician ... to practice while the physician ... is under investigation and the outcome of any disciplinary action taken by that facility or society against the physician

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: Require the person to participate in a program to correct an alcohol or other substance use disorder or any other impairment

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: the Board or committee may order that the physician ... undergo a mental or physical examination, an examination testing his or her competence to practice medicine ... or any other examination designated by the Board to assist the Board or committee in determining the fitness of the physician

administrative_medicine_license_availabl.quote: A person may apply to the Board to be licensed as an administrative physician if the person meets all of the statutory requirements for licensure in effect at the time of application except the requirements of paragraph (c) of subsection 2 of NRS 630.160.

locum_tenens_permit_available.quote: A locum tenens license, to be effective not more than 3 months after issuance, to any physician who is licensed and in good standing in another state, who meets the requirements for licensure in this State and who is of good moral character and reputation.

investigational_drug_protection.quote: A physician is not subject to disciplinary action for prescribing or recommending an individualized investigational treatment or investigational drug, biological product or device when authorized to do so pursuant to subsection 1.
